contract.application_relevance: Workers prepare an upload request then reuse a form builder for later work.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: Both request branches contain name=before,count=2 and no extra field; boundary from Content-Type matches framing.
contract.distinctness: Construction-time multipart extraction plus independent framing oracle. No duplicate count for the clone used as an observation tool.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.deep(t.multipartTextParts(wire, boundary), [['name', 'before'], ['count', '2']], 'independent multipart framing oracle sees construction-time entries');
t.equal(request.bodyUsed, false, 'consuming clone leaves original request unconsumed');
t.deep([...parsed], [['name', 'before'], ['count', '2']], 'original multipart request parses its construction-time entries');
t.equal(parsed.has('extra'), false, 'later FormData additions cannot alter extracted request body');
contract.hypothesis: A request body may consult a later-mutated FormData or advertise a boundary different from the bytes it actually contains.
contract.mechanism: FormData BodyInit serialization and boundary/body consistency
preconditions: Reviewed exact direct-celld source/build/deployment pins and fresh isolated local store.
Native celld Blob, File, FormData, Request, Response, and ReadableStream globals; no mocks or implementation extraction.
External five-second case deadline plus independent 300-second suite deadline and owned cleanup are active.

schedule.parallelism: two local body consumers joined with allSettled only in Y220; otherwise sequential

contract.source_observation: Pinned typed extraction eagerly serializes multipart bytes and sets its generated media type. The independent oracle accepts optional final CRLF and header-name casing rather than pinning incidental formatting.
